newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Bank of Punjab up 9.92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Bank of Punjab up 9.92 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Bank of Punjab climbed 2.35 rupees, or 9.92 percent, to 26.05 on Thursday on hopes that Pakistan Muslim League leader Nawaz Sharif would win Monday's election, brokers said.
Turnover of 354,000 shares of the stock had been recorded at the Karachi bourse by midsession.
"Bank of Punjab rose on hopes of a election win for Nawaz Sharif," dealer Shoaib Memon said. Shariff is seen as being pro-business.
Shoaib said many other companies based in populous Punjab, Sharif's home province, had gained on expectations of Sharif's victory in the national and provincial assembly elections.
The Punjab provincial government holds most of the shares in Bank of Punjab.
